basic_info.description: Experience the pinnacle of urban living in this exquisite South Beach penthouse loft, nestled on tranquil Tabor Alley. Adjacent to South Parkwhere locals unwind and VC's lean in over lunchyou'll find yourself surrounded by vibrant cafes, breweries, and restaurants. This prime location offers seamless access to the Fidi, Embarcadero, Oracle Park, and CalTrain, catering to those who aspire to live, work, and play in close proximity.  This South facing, tri level residence is bathed in natural light, exuding modern sophistication with thoughtfully curated upgrades throughout. The main level features soaring 18-foot ceilings that frame an open-concept floor plan, ideal for entertaining. The kitchen stands out with its sleek European cabinetry, top-tier appliances, and a striking Calacatta marble accent wall. An updated half bath and view deck complete this level.  Descend to the serene lower level, where you'll find a custom shoji bed enclosure, a cozy den, and a luxurious full bath. The upper loft level offers a built-in Murphy bed, custom closet system, and a remodeled full bath, making it perfect for a guest suite or home office.  This exceptional loft embodies contemporary elegance and provides an unparalleled blend of luxury and convenience in the heart of San Francisco.
